## Skill

- Bucket:
- Path: `skills/<bucket>/<name>/SKILL.md`

## Checklist

- [ ] Frontmatter `name` matches the folder name
- [ ] `description` says what and when (one or two sentences)
- [ ] Bucket README lists the skill
- [ ] Promoted skills are also in root README + `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, or vendored Oracle docs
